Hi Dana / Alex —

Thanks again for taking time to speak yesterday; I know the calendar conflict came up at the end and we missed locking the technical deep-dive. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Key priorities: reduce inference cost per 1M tokens (target: -35%), tighten 95th percentile latency to <280ms for the search use case, and ensure dedicated routing for PII-containing requests.
- Primary stakeholders: Dana (Ops), Alex (SRE), and you indicated Platform would want a short pilot.

Next tangible step: 45m technical deep-dive with an engineer + solutions architect where we walk through latency profiles, batching knobs, and a short pilot plan. I carved three compact windows for the next week — each firm but short; please pick one and we will reserve infra for the demo. If we don't hear back by EOD Wednesday PDT I'll release the slots so we can re-prioritize our pilot queue.

Proposed windows (all PDT):
1) Tue 2028-07-25 10:00–10:45
2) Wed 2028-07-26 14:00–14:45
3) Thu 2028-07-27 09:00–09:45

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf (agenda + checklist), prelim-sow_optimize.docx (draft SOW for pilot).

If none of these work, share two 30–45m windows and we will try to accommodate — but the slots above are held for 48 hours.

Quick asks in your reply: 1) confirm slot, 2) any additional invitees (security / procurement), 3) whether you'd like a canary run of the estimator before the call.

Thanks —
